title: Civil & Structural Engineer
abstract: Design civil and structural solutions across mining, industrial and infrastructure projects. Apply your 12d expertise, influence outcomes.

content_text:
Civil & Structural Engineer | Engineering
Brisbane | Civil & Structural Design
- Take designs from concept and calculations through to practical, constructible outcomes
- Work across civil and structural projects 
- Build your technical range across Energy & Resources, industrial and infrastructure work
The Opportunity
Fyfe is growing its civil and structural capability in Brisbane, creating an opportunity for an early-career engineer who wants to do more than model someone else's design.
Reporting to the Civil Design Manager or Team Leader, you'll work across multiple projects, producing civil and structural designs, calculations and documentation. You'll have the opportunity to build genuine design ownership, apply your engineering judgement and see your work progress from concept through to construction.
This role will suit someone with hands-on 12d experience who has been actively involved in design, not solely modelling or drafting. You'll contribute across civil and structural disciplines on residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure projects, with a strong preference for experience in mining or other non-road environments. 
The Impact You'll Have
- Deliver civil designs covering stormwater, drainage, earthworks, site services and supporting infrastructure.
- Produce structural designs for footing systems, slabs, retaining walls, and steel and concrete structures.
- Apply your design thinking in 12d Model, taking an active role in developing solutions rather than simply producing models.
- Coordinate with engineers, designers and drafters to create accurate, well-documented and constructible drawings.
- Manage assigned project components to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
- Liaise with clients, councils and contractors, and participate in design meetings and site inspections.
- Strengthen team capability by sharing knowledge and supporting graduate engineers as your experience develops. 
What You'll Bring
You'll be a technically capable engineer who is ready to take greater ownership of design and broaden your experience across diverse project environments.
- A Bachelor of Engineering in Civil, Structural or a related engineering discipline
- Approximately 2–4 years of post-graduate civil and/or structural engineering experience
- Hands-on experience using 12d Model, supported by practical involvement in civil design
- Demonstrated experience developing engineering solutions, calculations and documentation, rather than modelling alone
- Experience across projects outside a predominantly road-based environment
- Sound knowledge of relevant Australian Standards, engineering codes and authority requirements
- Clear communication skills and the ability to manage your workload across multiple project priorities
Experience in mining, resources, industrial facilities or associated infrastructure would be highly regarded. Experience with software such as SPACE GASS, Microstran or AutoCAD, and progress towards Chartered Professional Engineer status, would also be valuable. 
Why Fyfe?
Fyfe is an Australian multidisciplinary consultancy specialising in engineering, environment, planning and surveying. We partner with clients across Energy & Resources, Renewables, Infrastructure and Property, delivering practical solutions that support the energy transition and critical infrastructure projects shaping Australia's future. 
In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:
- Build genuine design experience across both civil and structural engineering
- Work on varied projects beyond a narrow road-design focus
- Learn directly from experienced engineers while developing greater independence
- See your designs progress from calculations and models into practical project outcomes
- Contribute to the technical capability and quality standards of a collaborative team
Interested?
If you're ready to move beyond modelling and take a more active role in engineering design, we'd like to hear from you.
Join Fyfe and help deliver practical civil and structural solutions for the projects shaping Australia's future.
Only candidates who are Australian Citizens, Permanent Residents or hold full Australian working rights will be considered.
Agency applications will not be accepted.
For more information, please contact careers@fyfe.com.au.
